central_candidate.name: CONSUME_BOUND_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT
central_candidate.statement: For any state, artifact, identity, capability, causal receipt, authority decision, training split or provider result that can influence persistent state or an effect, recording provenance is insufficient: the exact consumer must verify that the provenance and identity still bind the exact object/epoch/action being consumed, and consumption semantics must be replay-safe where mutation is possible.

converging_independent_mechanism_classes.finding: V3 could validate the private SQLite object yet still run after system-site preinitialization had already mutated high-level sqlite behavior; V4 moves admission to python -I -S before import-capable Frank code.

Path identity was insufficient because same-path executable bytes could drift after successful probes; candidate binds capability evidence to exact executable artifact bytes/filesystem identity and rechecks at use.
Provider/adapter output must remain data and cannot overwrite authorization/reservation/execution-generation/capability hard bindings.
A valid terminal outcome receipt can be reread; exactly-once persistent reward consumption is therefore a separate unresolved requirement.
Binding a semantic-audit receipt hash improves lineage but does not verify the audit receipt content/correctness; audit identity and audit validity remain distinct.
Accepted-target episode/signal/causal identity splices could still reach DONE and learning; GWT causal ancestry therefore must be storage- or receipt-enforced, not caller-carried metadata.
Disposable schema-pair and producer-bound V17 runs can both be green without forming one atomic whole-product composition; composition identity must be explicit.

anti_echo.shared_ancestry_warning: The repeated pattern across branches is cross-branch convergence, not independent replication, because many lanes share Clay/Frank/UnifiedDB/effect-receipt ancestry.
anti_echo.promotion_rule: Promote only after branch-specific falsifiers plus at least one integrated consumer-bound composition test on the accepted target.

authority_boundary: This fusion creates research/test obligations only; it grants no Frank self-Harness authority and no effect or training authority.
